source.description:
Second comm-runtime bead (discovered-from coordinator input). Persisted obligation record created ATOMICALLY with each semantic request: requester participant_id, channel/message ref, responder action_target, correlation id, state machine requested->replied->settled (plus expired/voided), idempotency key per R2.6.

Invariants preserved: provider accepted != processed != replied (three distinct receipt points); read != ack; reply correlation must be atomic — no window where a reply can arrive before the obligation exists or after it is lost; uncertain outcomes block blind replay and reconciliation records resolving evidence (R2.7).

No polling API for agents: the obligation is runtime-owned bookkeeping, not agent memory.
